content.text: They drink long and well from the beers.

And then there's a long beat.
Longer than is funny.
Long enough to be depressing.
The men look at each other.

Tabs at the start are kept.
    So are four spaces.
He opens the card. A simple little number inside of which is hand written:

Scott --
          Jacob Billups
          Palace Hotel, RM 412
          1:00 pm tomorrow
Scott exasperatedly throws down the card on the table and picks up the phone.
